entity.summary: Non-custodial Sui wallet ecosystem created by combining the Sui Wallet and Stashed product lineages under the Slush brand in 2025.
entity.notes: Mysten Labs explicitly states that Sui Wallet and Stashed were combined into Slush on 2025-04-24 while existing Sui Wallet accounts, seed phrases and addresses continued without migration. The rebrand date is not treated as the initial wallet launch date.

products.summary: Current Slush browser-extension wallet continuing the former Sui Wallet extension lineage.
products.notes: Mysten Labs states existing Sui Wallet extension users received Slush through a standard update without a new download or migration. Slush mobile/web surfaces are deferred. The 2025-04-24 rebrand is not used as the original extension launch date.

events.title: Sui Wallet and Stashed unified under the Slush brand
events.description: Mysten Labs announced that Sui Wallet and Stashed were becoming Slush, with existing Sui Wallet users receiving the new name and interface through the standard update path rather than a separate wallet migration.
events.notes: WLR uses `rebranded` rather than `merged` because the selected existing wallet product continues through the standard update path under the Slush identity; Stashed functionality is acknowledged in the description without creating an unsupported second canonical product relationship.

evidence.title: Sui Wallet and Stashed are now Slush
evidence.notes: First-party Mysten Labs announcement establishes Sui Wallet + Stashed → Slush continuity and states existing accounts, seed phrases and wallet addresses remain unchanged.

evidence.title: Slush Terms of Service
evidence.notes: Current Slush terms describe the wallet as non-custodial/unhosted and state Slush does not take custody or control of assets or keys.

evidence.title: Sui Wallet and Stashed are Now Slush
evidence.notes: First-party Mysten Labs announcement states Sui Wallet and Stashed are now Slush and says existing Sui Wallet users receive the change through a standard update without a new download or account migration.
